verdict.rationale: Synthesia is an AI video generator, so extending a clip or regenerating a single segment is a fair question for it. The evidence only mentions general editability, such as "fully editable" PPT-to-video, collaborative editing workflows, and editable transcripts before dubbing. Nothing shows segment-level regeneration, clip extension, or partial re-rendering that avoids rendering the whole video again.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video
